counting_rule: one distinct method with trigger, procedure, failure mode, evidence, and source binding
research_stop_rule: three consecutive coverage loops yielded zero new admissible method units

methods.name: Problem-before-interface gate
methods.trigger: Before selecting an AI feature or drawing a screen
procedure: Identify the user and valued outcome
Test whether AI adds a unique strength
Reject the feature if the AI advantage is not evidenced
methods.success: The proposed AI capability solves a demonstrated need better than the baseline.
methods.failure: A visually attractive AI feature is built without a validated user problem.
methods.source_locator: Identify user needs and AI strengths
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue established that UI/UX review must start with business/service purpose rather than visual design.

methods.name: Outcome-and-harm reward design
procedure: List downstream harms and affected roles
Review the reward with a cross-functional group
methods.success: Optimization improves the user outcome without breaching guardrails.
methods.failure: The system maximizes clicks, speed, or model score while degrading trust, safety, or task completion.
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue required user, creator, administrator, operator, business, and auditor perspectives.

methods.name: Capability and limitation disclosure
methods.trigger: At first use and before consequential AI action
procedure: Explain what the system can do
Show the data or context used when useful
methods.success: Users form a calibrated mental model and choose appropriate tasks.
methods.failure: Human-like presentation causes users to assume unsupported accuracy or authority.
methods.source_locator: Guidelines for Human-AI Interaction and Design Library
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue prohibited calling unregistered or unvalidated candidates learned.

methods.name: Uncertainty-visible output
methods.trigger: When AI output can be incomplete, ambiguous, or wrong
procedure: Represent uncertainty at the decision point
Offer alternatives when confidence is insufficient
Block irreversible action under the threshold
methods.success: The user can distinguish reliable, uncertain, and unavailable output.
methods.failure: All generated outputs look equally authoritative.
methods.conversation_binding: ORUDA requires Candidate, PASS, HOLD, and Final states to remain visibly distinct.

methods.name: Correction and recovery loop
methods.trigger: After an AI recommendation or generation
procedure: Preserve the original and edited lineage
methods.success: A user can safely recover without restarting or losing provenance.
methods.failure: The user must accept, discard everything, or silently overwrite AI output.
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue requires OTester/OAudit validation before promotion.

methods.name: Feedback-loop integrity
methods.trigger: When user feedback changes future AI behaviour
procedure: Measure downstream behaviour and abuse risk
methods.success: Feedback is attributable, reversible, and improves the intended behaviour.
methods.failure: A thumbs-up/down control exists but its effect is unknown or misinterpreted.
methods.conversation_binding: The user requested continual accumulation only after deduplication and actual registration.

methods.name: Human authority at consequential boundaries
methods.trigger: For approval, payment, release, safety, legal, or production decisions
methods.success: AI assists the decision while authority and accountability remain unambiguous.
methods.failure: Automation bias turns a suggestion into an unreviewed final action.
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue separates creator, administrator, operator, tester, and auditor responsibilities.

methods.name: AI-generated layout contract
methods.trigger: When AI generates UI screens or visual assets
procedure: Generate against fixed geometry and design tokens
Preserve content hierarchy and accessibility semantics
Render and inspect the actual canvas
methods.success: Generated UI is editable, traceable, responsive, and visually stable.
methods.failure: A plausible image bypasses component, geometry, accessibility, or lineage contracts.
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue fixed Geometry Contract, canonical Scene, render hash, and actual overlap/clipping inspection.

methods.name: Role-complete workflow simulation
methods.trigger: Before accepting an AI-created service flow
procedure: Run administrator policy and permission changes
methods.success: All roles can complete normal, exception, and recovery work with consistent state.
methods.failure: Only the end-user happy path is designed.
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue explicitly required user, creator, administrator, and operator perspectives plus audit.

methods.name: Semantic deduplication before learning
procedure: Count only materially distinct situation-action-result-validation units
methods.success: The corpus grows by distinct reusable knowledge rather than paraphrase volume.
methods.failure: Requested counts are met by changing labels, roles, or proficiency levels.
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue found 2,016 records were 7 proficiency levels × 4 perspectives × 72 topics and excluded them.

methods.name: Three-loop saturation review
procedure: Loop 2: adversarially search gaps and counterexamples
Loop 3: deduplicate and repeat the same source scope
Stop only when the loop produces zero admissible unique units
methods.success: The declared scope reaches an evidenced saturation point.
methods.failure: Research stops when an arbitrary target count is reached.
methods.source_locator: User instruction for 2-3 loops until no additional learning material remains
methods.conversation_binding: The user removed numeric limits and required maximum investigation without omission.

methods.name: Dual independent promotion gate
methods.trigger: Before moving candidate UI/UX knowledge into the official corpus
procedure: OTester checks schema, lineage, source binding, uniqueness, and fixtures
OAudit recalculates bindings and checks false-pass/final risks
methods.success: Registered, validated, promoted, and merged counts are equal for the promoted set.
methods.failure: Candidate creation or local validation is reported as learning completion.
methods.source_locator: Required lifecycle: register, independent validate, promote, merge, evidence report
methods.conversation_binding: The dialogue repeatedly prohibited describing unregistered material as learned.
